role.tpm: Works with the Product Manager: assigns issues to seats and relays their messages. There is only one seat, but it stays up and runs on every message, so it has many turns.
role.softwareEngineer: Owns one issue: investigates, proposes, plans, implements and tests. It has the most seats and runs implementation and tests over long contexts, so its cost tends to be large.
role.staffEngineer: Reviews the plans, proposals and PRs the issue's seat asks for and returns a verdict (does not fix). Its effort is high and it reads diffs deeply, so each turn tends to cost more.
role.techLead: Coordinates an issue that spans several repositories: writes the plan and the agreements between repositories, starts a seat per repository, and reviews their plans and PRs.
role.devopsEngineer: Builds, deploys and maintains the shared environments (containers, the page store, callboard and so on). Runs only when asked.
role.sustainingEngineer: Owns one Dependabot PR: checks the time since the release, fixes CI, and asks for the merge.
role.auditor: Examines how the seats work, with evidence, and makes recommendations to the Product Manager (does not fix or decide). Runs only when the Product Manager starts it.

helper.generalPurpose: A catch-all helper the main seat hands research or multi-step work to. The skill that fixes figures (figure-fix) also runs on it. The bigger the task handed over, the bigger the cost.
helper.explore: A read-only helper that searches files and text and returns where things are, with excerpts. It repeats searches many times, so its turns tend to be many.
helper.plan: A read-only helper that drafts implementation plans.
helper.webFetch: A helper that fetches and reads web pages and returns a summarized answer.
helper.claudeCodeGuide: A helper that answers questions about using Claude Code and the Claude API by reading the docs.
helper.statuslineSetup: A helper that configures Claude Code's status line.
helper.auditReader: A read-only helper used only when the Auditor collects evidence for a case (the audit-evidence skill).
